changelog: Fix: editing the monthly goal now updates the progress %/bar under Übersicht. The recompute lived in a <script> that never runs when Übersicht injects the widget via innerHTML; moved it to an inline oninput handler (mirrors the working flip cards) and persist via an absolute 127.0.0.1:47900 URL with text/plain to avoid a CORS preflight. Also: the helper now binds its port before the initial WeRead fetch, so startup no longer stalls when there is no proxy env (e.g. under launchd).
